faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SMP Kolkata Chief Hydraulic Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the SMP Kolkata Chief Hydraulic Engineer Recruitment 2026 is 12th October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Chief Hydraulic Engineer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a 1st class degree in Civil Engineering, a post-graduate degree in Mathematics/Statistics, or a 1st class graduate degree in Electronics/Instrumentation/Electrical/Computer Science & Engineering with 15 years of relevant experience.
